description: Fetch matching log entries for this project, newest first. Use to inspect specific errors or recent activity. Call this when you need the actual log lines.

before_iso.description: Only entries before this ISO timestamp (cursor pagination).

minutes.description: Only entries from the last N minutes.

project_id.description: The project to query. Call list_projects first to see which ids you can use.

text.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the message.

name: query_logs
